title: This is a work of fiction
lead: Sawit Simulator is a game. The estate, the district, the co-operative and every official in it were invented for it.
point1Title: Nobody in this game is real.
point1: Every name, office, agency and company here was made up. Any resemblance to a real person, company or public body is coincidence, and nothing in the game is a statement about one.
point2: Nothing here is agricultural, legal, financial or political advice. The numbers are tuned to make a game work, not to describe any real plantation, market or regulation.
point3Title: Clearing land is a choice, not a lesson.
point3: The game lets you chop and burn because it is about what those choices cost. Neither is a recommendation.
marquee: This is a game about a palm oil farm estate. Real forests do not grow back on a timer. Support reforestation: even though this game is about palm oil farming...
